stories.title: TU Exam Form Registration Window Extended Through December
stories.summary: Tribhuvan University extended the undergraduate exam form submission window through December 31 2027 for pending backlogs.
stories.why_it_matters: Students with backlog forms get a long, clearly bounded submission window.
